webhook_receiver.description: Generic webhook receiver with HMAC validation routing to event bus
webhook_receiver.scaffold:
import hmac, hashlib
from fastapi import Request, HTTPException

@app.post('/webhook')
async def receive_webhook(request: Request):
    body = await request.body()
    sig = request.headers.get('X-Garcar-Signature', '')
    expected = hmac.new(WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, f'sha256={expected}'):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
    payload = await request.json()
    await event_bus.emit(f"garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.webhook.received", payload)
    return {"received": True}

auth_layer.description: JWT auth middleware protecting all routes except /health
auth_layer.scaffold:
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
import jwt

security = HTTPBearer()

async def verify_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)):
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=['HS256'])
        return payload
    except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Token expired')
    except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Invalid token')

auto_rollback.description: Deployment rollback trigger on health-check failure after deploy
auto_rollback.scaffold:
async def deployment_health_guard(deployment_id: str, timeout_seconds: int = 120):
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < timeout_seconds:
        await asyncio.sleep(10)
        resp = await http_client.get(f'{API_BASE}/health')
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.deploy.healthy', {"deployment_id": deployment_id})
            return True
    await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.deploy.rollback', {"deployment_id": deployment_id, "reason": "health_check_timeout"})
    await trigger_rollback(deployment_id)
    return False

drift_detection.description: Detects config drift vs expected state and triggers reconciliation
drift_detection.scaffold:
async def detect_drift():
    expected = await load_expected_config()
    actual = await load_actual_config()
    drifted_keys = [k for k in expected if expected[k] != actual.get(k)]
    if drifted_keys:
        await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.drift.detected', {"drifted_keys": drifted_keys, "severity": "high" if len(drifted_keys) > 3 else "low"})
        await reconcile_config(expected, actual)
